institutions.name: Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam
institutions.entity_note: VU Amsterdam (vu.nl). Includes programmes it delivers jointly with UvA (Archaeology MA, Chemistry, Physics and Astronomy, Computational Science, Computer Science, Bioinformatics and Systems Biology, Liberal Arts and Sciences/AUC, Tinbergen research masters). VU's own overview widget did not render, so the list is built from vu.nl's sitemap programme pages (29 bachelor and ~130 master pages, of which 20 bachelor and 106 master qualify). Master entries with track_of set are specialisations that VU lists on separate pages. Excluded: pre-masters, Dutch-taught (Biomedical Sciences BSc moves to Dutch from 2026-27, Health Sciences MSc, Spiritual Care), UNIGIS GIS (part-time), Creative Technology and Mechanical Engineering BSc (University of Twente-run joint programmes), Archaeology BA and Ancient Studies BA (page says 'Dutch / English' but English full degree not verifiable; Archaeology BA becomes a UvA-run joint degree from 2027-28).
